name: HarbourFront
summary: NEL/CCL harbour hub — VivoCity gravity, Sentosa adjacency, and dense condo/serviced edges with weekend mall crowds as the daily tax.
body: HarbourFront is the shortlist when North-East / Circle Line interchange access and mall / ferry / Sentosa adjacency matter. Housing is mostly condo and serviced-apartment stock rather than quiet HDB heartland; weekend VivoCity crowds and tourist spillover are the tax. Expats land here for car-light harbour living and multi-line hops, not cul-de-sac calm. Compare with Telok Blangah for a greener ridge feel, Redhill for denser EWL hawker texture, and Sentosa when you are already paying island premiums and want the beach walk.
bestFor: car-light workers who want two MRT lines and mall gravity
households okay with weekend tourist and mall crowds
renters comparing serviced vs proper TA nearby
people who will use ActiveSG gyms instead of trusting condo facilities
watchOuts: Facility brochure vs MA EV / bike-bay reality
housingMix: Dense condo and serviced-apartment stock with limited quiet HDB texture.
commuteNotes: North-East and Circle Line at HarbourFront; test a Saturday afternoon station exit before you romanticise the interchange.
